design.change: v0.1.13 scp4d_tdec_w with a short issue path: per-token range flags against D on queue entry (scp4d_fe_r), narrow gap arithmetic with a parallel signed range compare, pop-late token-queue update, parallel consumed-byte sums, registered D - 1 and last-frame flag, one-hot token view, dequantized step registered in stage A.
design.cycle_behaviour: identical to v0.1.13 (exact cycle model re-exported from scripts/scp-v0113-rtl-model.ts; lockstep trace compared every cycle)

synthesis.label: SYNTHESIS / PLACE-AND-ROUTE ESTIMATES from open-source tools (one seed, --freq 12 target; ECP5 with nextpnr --router router2; the v0.1.13 decoder, the v0.1.16 encoder and the v0.1.16 loop re-placed with the same flow as 'ref' rows for a like-for-like comparison). Not a programmed-FPGA or silicon measurement; no board was used. xc7: yosys cell counts only (no open-source timing).
synthesis.wrapper: hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_tdec_r_wrap.v: wrap_tdec_r = wrap_tdec_w (hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_pnr_wrap.v) with the decoder swapped; wrap_loop_r = wrap_loop_q (hw/scp4d/synth/scp4d_tenc_q_wrap.v) with the decoder swapped. Stream inputs on pins, outputs registered and XOR-folded to 16 pins. The same wrapper logic is added to the new and the reference configurations.
